source.author: verg
source.text: Accepit vocem lacrimis Lavinia matris flagrantis perfusa genas, quoi plurimus ignem subiecit rubor et calefacta per ora cucurrit.
source.text_original: Accepit vocem lacrimis Lavinia matris / flagrantis perfusa genas, quoi plurimus ignem / subiecit rubor et calefacta per ora cucurrit.
source.text_english: Lavinia received the words with tears, her cheeks drenched, her face aflame with her mother’s tears; deepest blush had kindled her fire, and the heat ran over her flushed features.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: in haec sacramenti uerba dimissus reuertor ad superos et mirantibus cunctis oculos aperio tanto lacrimarum imbre perfusos, ut etiam incredulis fidem facerent ex dolore.
reuse.text_original: in haec sacramenti uerba dimissus reuertor ad superos et mirantibus cunctis oculos aperio tanto lacrimarum imbre perfusos, ut etiam incredulis fidem facerent ex dolore.
reuse.text_english: Released to these words of the sacrament, I return to the living above, and in the wonder of all I open my eyes, drenched with such a flood of tears that they would have won belief even from unbelievers by their sorrow.
